name: optimizely-remko-migration-discovery
description: Discovery skill that inventories a customer's Remko usage and routes to the applicable surface-specific migration skills.

cases.name: full-suite-detection
cases.prompt: Our codebase uses @remkoj/optimizely-cms-react, @remkoj/optimizely-cms-nextjs, @remkoj/optimizely-graph-client, @remkoj/optimizely-graph-functions, @remkoj/optimizely-graph-cli, @remkoj/optimizely-cms-cli, and @remkoj/optimizely-cms-api. Which migration skills do we need and in what order?
expected_behaviours: Names all 7 surface-specific Remko migration skills
Orders them: graph-client first, cms-react before cms-nextjs, cms-api last
Prompts the user to check for patches, wrappers, and forked codegen before starting

cases.name: partial-usage
cases.prompt: We only import from @remkoj/optimizely-cms-react and @remkoj/optimizely-cms-nextjs. Should we install all seven migration skills?
expected_behaviours: Says no — only the two applicable skills apply
Notes cms-react must run before cms-nextjs
Confirms cms-api / cms-cli / graph-cli / graph-functions are not needed if not imported

cases.name: patched-remko-detection
expected_behaviours: Flags the patch as a customer artifact requiring reconciliation
Advises reading the patch to catalogue behaviours before removing the package
